summary: First iteration: Full backend + frontend testing for CT Warrior Academy Management. All 37 backend pytest cases passed (auth/RBAC/students/teachers/modalities/classes/plans/enrollments/invoices/attendance/graduations/announcements/dashboards). Frontend login → admin dashboard flow, sidebar navigation and student creation via modal all working.

minor.issue: Matrícula generator uses count_documents()+1, so after deletes or concurrent inserts it can produce DUPLICATE matriculas (observed CT00004 appearing twice in UI). Should use a counter collection ($inc on findAndModify) or ensure uniqueness with retry.
revenue_series computes months via (today - timedelta(days=i*30)).replace(day=1). This can skip/duplicate months near month boundaries; use dateutil relativedelta or explicit month math.
No duplicate enrollment check (same student+class can enroll multiple times) and no capacity check against class.capacity.
Uses delete_many + insert (not atomic); concurrent calls could lose data. Prefer upsert.

issues: Recharts responsive containers emit width(-1)/height(-1) warnings until sized. Consider adding minWidth/minHeight to ResponsiveContainer wrappers.
Radix Dialog missing aria-describedby/Description → accessibility warning. Add DialogDescription.

action_items: Fix duplicate matricula generation (use atomic counter, not count_documents).
Add DialogDescription to shadcn Dialogs to remove a11y warning.
Add capacity + duplicate check to POST /api/enrollments.
Attendance POST: use upsert instead of delete+insert.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/students.py _next_matricula() has a race condition and reuses ids after deletions – causes duplicate matriculas in production.
auth cookies use samesite='none' + secure=True which is fine over HTTPS ingress; make sure preview URL is served over TLS (it is).
Consistent good practice: _clean() drops _id everywhere; Pydantic ConfigDict extra='ignore' guards inputs; bcrypt hashes verified starting with $2b$.
seed_admin is idempotent and updates password on mismatch – matches playbook expectation.
brute-force lockout logic present (5 attempts / 15min) – validated indirectly.

All /api routes are correctly prefixed; CORS allow_credentials with '*' origins works because backend also accepts Bearer tokens; but if strict CORS is enforced in production, explicit origins are required.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, dashboard KPIs, sidebar nav to alunos/modalidades/turmas, student creation via modal, list refresh, toast success)

seed_data_creation: Tests self-create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed students, teachers, modalities, classes, plan, enrollment, invoice (paid), attendance, graduation, announcement. Cleanup class deletes them at the end. UI test created 1 residual student 'Aluno UI Test <ts>' via preview – can be cleaned by main agent if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is authoritative – run with `-n 0` (serial) because tests share a session-scoped state fixture; xdist loadscope will break state. Do NOT run in parallel. Preview URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin is seeded automatically on startup.
rca of the issue: N/A – no blocking issues. Duplicate matricula root cause: `count_documents({}) + 1` is not monotonic (recycles after delete) and not atomic (race on concurrent inserts). Fix: db.counters.find_one_and_update({_id:'student_matricula'}, {$inc:{seq:1}}, upsert=True, return_document=AFTER).
